items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: The best bands I heard before I went out on my own was the mysterious mistral bands, such as the Rabbit Foot, A.G. Allen Mistral...

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the danced orchestras or bands around? What kind of music they played? What? How big the bands were? What kind of a band? What kind of music? If it was ragtime or waltzes or what kind of music they played?

Oh, well, I heard several of the bands. The best bands I heard before I went out on my own was the mysterious mistral bands, such as the Rabbit Foot, A.G. Allen Mistral, and, uh, The Dandy Dixie Mistral, The Georgia Mistral, The Algae Fields, The Blue Dock Stata. I heard it all about that.
Um, how late, uh, how long did you stay in Texarkana?
